notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 101 from 17 April 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/1CJQuqM89I7hWA9KYvjCop?si=arncPmZ1SseRp6Atuf1ilw) with @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. MultiMach CCX has the lightweight frame's +20 Mobility and +6.25% speed bonus, and the stats are great - it's just a shame there's nothing here to get excited about for PvE. If you must (really?), look for stability to help with keeping shots on target and then - are you absolutely insisting still? - Attrition Orbs or Under Over in the first trait perk column, and Frenzy with Kinetic Tremors in a distant second. Of the origin traits, Field Tested provides solid escalating gunfeel boosts for landing hits, as long as you don't die. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "How do we feel about lightweight submachine guns in PvE content? Well, if it’s not named CALUS Mini-Tool, I don’t think they are the best option. Multimach is no exception. Frenzy will give you the easiest damage bonus and increase our reload speed. Target Lock and Kinetic Tremors will both have utility in PvE activities, but won’t have as much utility without a reload perk in column 3." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Multimach is back and boy do I have conflicting views on this. Should we invest in lethality or consistency? Iron Reach will be incredible in 3v3 game modes, as well as Trials and potentially in Rumble, but Kill Clip will be even better for 6v6 game modes or slayers. Ideally you’ll find a healthy mix of range and stability, but Dynamic Sway Reduction will cover most of your stability if you opt for Iron Reach. If you prefer Kill Clip, then I would recommend Moving Target for better movement speed and being that quick slayer we all know you are." Recommended MW: Range or Stability.

Inspired by DMB Podcast 264 conversation with @pattycakesGG. PvP first-choice A-Tier roll for kill-chaining. Not obtainable as at S17, unfortunately, but even after the Zoom nerf it's still very good. Push out range and zoom as far as you can with your sight, mag and Masterwork. Killing Wind adds useful stat boosts (including range) after a kill and Iron Reach passively extends the range still further, albeit at the expense of stability. Masterwork: Range, with a Sprint Grip or Quick Access Sling, if you're playing aggressively, or a Targeting Adjustor for more passive playstyles.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range] "The Multimach is a firm favourite of SMG aficionados in high-level PvP. While some farm for explicitly strict rolls, this recommendation has perks for those at different skill levels / platforms included. Typically, you'll want to maximise Range wherever possible, with Stability being crucial on Console, though not really a consideration on PC (opening up options like Iron Reach). Kill Clip is great if you are someone able to reliably chain kills, otherwise Iron Grip may suit you during the 900RPM adjustment period (huge Stability buff). Threat Detector comes down to personal preference - some players prefer a uniform handling experience, some appreciate the sudden buffs." tags:god-pvp
